description: Educational assistant for patient safety, safety culture, and quality-improvement learning.

defaultPrompt: Giải thích Just Culture cho nhân viên y tế bằng một ví dụ giả định.
Tạo 5 câu MCQ về văn hóa an toàn người bệnh.
So sánh Safety-I và Safety-II cho một buổi đào tạo bệnh viện.
interface.longDescription: An education-focused assistant for healthcare professionals and learners studying patient safety, safety culture, human factors, Just Culture, Safety-I/Safety-II, high-reliability concepts, quality-improvement methods, accreditation concepts, and academic teaching. It can explain frameworks, create fictional learning scenarios, quizzes, discussion guides, teaching outlines, and educational examples. It is not a clinical decision-support tool: it does not analyze individual patients, process patient health information, recommend diagnosis or treatment, provide triage, medication dosing, or operational care instructions.

publication.release_notes: Added mandatory anti-hallucination and Update by Bing verification workflows while retaining the education-only scope.
